command:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main plot-inbox; git reset --hard origin/main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kobra-chat-ready.XXXXXX); git show de057fd3a4250dd795e421cdff1d9d087f954b5d:projects/kobra2-neo/inbox/botanical-chat-ingest.svg > "$TMP/source.svg"; ACTUAL=$(shasum -a 256 "$TMP/source.svg" | awk '{print $1}'); test "$ACTUAL" = "8d3f26b2354b30a9cd0671e93c6c2137973ab23330cc0cecbd6cdb30ea28a945"; cd projects/kobra2-neo; uv sync --frozen >/dev/null; START=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic())'); uv run kobra-plot prepare "$TMP/source.svg" -o "$TMP/job"; SHA=$(python3 - "$TMP/job/report.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r['safety']['valid'] is True
assert r['execution']['allowed'] is False
assert r['profile']['pen_up_z'] == 4.97
assert r['profile']['pen_down_z'] == 2.97
assert r['profile']['motion']['travel_feed'] == 6000.0
assert r['profile']['motion']['draw_feed'] == 2400.0
assert r['profile']['motion']['z_feed'] == 360.0
print(r['artifacts']['gcode_sha256'])
PY
); uv run kobra-live "$TMP/job/output.gcode" --report "$TMP/job/report.json" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --validate-only; END=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic())'); ELAPSED=$(python3 - "$START" "$END" <<'PY'
import sys
print(f'{float(sys.argv[2])-float(sys.argv[1]):.3f}')
PY
); echo RESULT:READY_TO_PRINT elapsed_seconds=$ELAPSED source_sha256=$ACTUAL gcode_sha256=$SHA job_dir=$TMP/job
